main.name: Jeremiah Butler
main.occupation: Software Engineer · Building Autonomous AI Systems
main.description: 10+ years across high-scale commerce, enterprise cloud, and defense. Now building autonomous AI systems
main.bio: Problem solver and software engineer with 10+ years shipping production systems across high-scale commerce ($300B+ GMV at Shopify), enterprise cloud, and defense. Now building autonomous AI systems: agents, orchestration, and the platforms behind them. Go, Rust, and C++ on Kubernetes; applied ML from edge inference to autonomous agents.

work.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Built autonomous agent systems: integrated coding agents with Shopify's durable agent infrastructure (Aquifer/River), a voice-controlled conductor agent orchestrating multiple agent sessions via an agent control plane, and automated support-request triage

Drove AI-assisted engineering on the team: built a Rust terminal multiplexer for managing concurrent agent sessions and work items; authored code-review agent skills adopted by teammates; presented autonomous agent-loop techniques to hundreds of engineers on Shopify's internal broadcast platform
Owned the platform Subscriptions and Pre-orders APIs that all Shopify subscription apps build on
Built and maintained the open-source Subscriptions reference app: Shopify's first-party subscriptions product and the foundation enterprise merchants fork for bespoke subscription experiences
Restructured team on-call and resiliency practices; burned down a backlog of ~20 resiliency issues to zero in 4 months while intake continued

2x project champion for cross-team initiatives spanning B2B, checkout, legal, and UX; authored 2 RFCs and owned 2 design docs for core data-model changes; mentored a junior engineer to a senior promotion

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Developed a hybrid-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) monitoring solution for the SevOne Network Performance Management platform
Published a generalized ETL collection framework, adopted into SevOne for data collection
Served as the model team for the company-wide agile + DevOps migration

work.title: Advanced Software Engineer / Software Lead
bullets: Led multiple teams to test events and contract awards totaling $30M+
Architected cloud-based mission systems for DoD; led internal research bringing ML to the tactical edge
Built an innersource community with 100+ reusable projects; presented the concept to 130+ participants
